case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
sup:70530.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Your offer gave us a clear picture of where you see copper and labour costs, and what we can offer is planning security: a binding volume over a longer contract, which your pricing committee can plan against.

Option A is the package we can approve. It commits us to the binding volume for the full contract term, and the two points below show why the price in it is the right one to take forward.

On demand:
Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On our order history:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.33; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 415.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Please take Option A to the committee for approval.

Beyond the options, there are things that cost us nothing. We will act as a reference customer for your other clients, share our rolling forecast with you every quarter, approve your invoices within days of receipt, and name you a preferred supplier for this part family.

If your committee needs anything further to approve Option A, we will gladly provide it. What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data and volume change data you cited; both hold and we took them into account. We have verified your order history and forecast data; while our base pricing is constrained, the planning security of a longer agreement allows us to adjust our position. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. However, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We are prepared to build on your Option C by accepting the 24-month contract term and the 45-day payment period. With these terms in place, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 429.43.

Our offer comprises a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €429.43 per unit. A price of €429.43 per unit is also available with Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
